bilibili.label: B站视频评论
bilibili.ident: 视频 BV 号，如 BV1WtAGzYEBm
bilibili.author: author
bilibili.note: 需要 Chrome 已登录 B站 + OpenCLI 扩展。comments-all 会翻页拿全量。
bilibili.ident_en: Video id (the BV…) — a full video link works too
bilibili.note_en: comments-all pages through the whole thread so the percentages are not dominated by the hottest comments.

weibo.label: 微博评论
weibo.ident: 微博正文 id（idstr 数字）
weibo.author: author
weibo.note: 需要登录。官方接口一页上限 50 条。
weibo.note_en: Needs a logged-in browser (opencli uses your cookies).

xiaohongshu.label: 小红书笔记评论
xiaohongshu.ident: 完整笔记 URL（必须带 xsec_token，从浏览器地址栏复制）
xiaohongshu.author: author
xiaohongshu.note: 需要登录；带 xsec_token 的 URL 才有效，过期的会失败。
xiaohongshu.ident_en: Full note URL (must carry xsec_token — copy it from the address bar)
xiaohongshu.note_en: The xsec_token part is what makes the note readable; an id alone cannot be opened.

zhihu.label: 知乎回答评论
zhihu.ident: 回答 URL 或 answer id
zhihu.author: author
zhihu.note: 评论挂在「回答」下面：打开某条回答，复制它的链接（…/answer/123456789）或直接填那串数字。问题页没有问题评论。
zhihu.note_en: Comments hang off an ANSWER: open one, copy its link (…/answer/123456789) or just type those digits. A question page has no comments.

youtube.label: YouTube 视频评论
youtube.ident: 视频 URL 或 video id
youtube.author: author
youtube.note: 需要登录；一次最多 100 条。
youtube.note_en: Needs a login; at most 100 per pull.

v2ex.label: V2EX 帖子回复
v2ex.ident: 话题 id（t/ 后面的数字）
v2ex.author: author
v2ex.note: PUBLIC：不需要浏览器、不需要登录，拿来试流程最方便。
v2ex.note_en: PUBLIC: no browser, no login — handy to try the flow.

hackernews.label: Hacker News 讨论
hackernews.ident: 帖子 id（item?id=49750694 里的数字）
hackernews.author: author
hackernews.note: PUBLIC：不用登录、不用浏览器。默认只统计顶层评论（L0）—— 帖子本体、楼中楼回复、以及「[+N more replies]」这类没有作者的占位行都不计数。想连楼中楼一起统计，把 run 里的 --depth 改成 2 并删掉 skip 里的 L1。
hackernews.note_en: PUBLIC: no browser, no login. Counts top-level comments (L0) only — the story itself, nested replies and the "[+N more replies]" placeholders are left out. Set --depth 2 and drop L1 from skip to include nested replies.
